stemMd: What did the survey reveal about many borrowers?

options.label: A
options.textMd: They already owned every tool they borrowed.

options.label: B
options.textMd: They wanted the library to stop lending books.

options.label: C
options.textMd: They borrowed tools mainly to resell them.

options.label: D
options.textMd: They used borrowed tools to try repairs before buying equipment.

options.label: E
options.textMd: They had stopped visiting the hardware shop entirely.

explanationMd: The first paragraph explicitly describes borrowers trying unfamiliar repairs before deciding whether to buy. This supports experimentation as a benefit. The other claims either contradict the reported sales result or introduce activities absent from the passage.

distractorRationale.e: The passage says shop sales had not fallen.
distractorRationale.a: The survey concerns experimenting before possible purchases.
distractorRationale.b: The passage says nothing about abandoning book lending.
